topic.angle: Supply must meet demand at every moment

card.title: The grid has no spare shelf

body.claim: On a big electricity grid, generation and consumption must stay balanced, because energy is consumed as it is produced.
body.why: The grid's AC frequency shows how things stand: it falls slightly when the grid is heavily loaded and rises when lightly loaded, and utilities adjust generation to keep it steady. In the immediate short term, the spinning generators themselves store energy as rotational motion.

True or false: on a synchronous grid, generation and consumption must be balanced across the whole grid.

claims.claim: Generation and consumption must be balanced because energy is consumed as produced (claim, probe 2)
claims.quote: Generation and consumption must be balanced across the entire grid, because energy is consumed as it is produced.

claims.claim: Frequency falls when heavily loaded, rises when lightly loaded (probe 1)
claims.quote: reducing when the grid is heavily loaded, and speeding up when lightly loaded

claims.claim: Utilities adjust generation to keep frequency steady
claims.quote: most utilities will adjust generation onto the grid over the course of the day to ensure a constant number of cycles occur

claims.claim: Spinning generators store energy as rotation in the short term
claims.quote: Energy is stored in the immediate short term by the rotational kinetic energy of the generators.
